crossRefs.note: Daughter of my people, clothe yourself with sackcloth, and wallow in ashes! Mourn, as for an only son, most bitter…
In their streets, they clothe themselves in sackcloth. In their streets and on their housetops, everyone wails, weeping…
In that day, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, called to weeping, to mourning, to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth;
Tremble, you women who are at ease! Be troubled, you careless ones! Strip yourselves, make yourselves naked, and put…
“Yet even now,” says Yahweh, “turn to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning.”
Tear your heart, and not your garments, and turn to Yahweh, your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger…
I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will make you wear sackcloth on all…
Moab is disappointed; for it is broken down. Wail and cry! Tell it by the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.
Wail, for Yahweh’s day is at hand! It will come as destruction from the Almighty.

Therefore Yahweh’s anger burns against his people, and he has stretched out his hand against them and has struck them.…
The Syrians in front, and the Philistines behind; and they will devour Israel with open mouth. For all this, his anger…
Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men, neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and…
Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh; and they together shall be against Judah. For all this his anger is not…
They will only bow down under the prisoners, and will fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away…

translations.web: For this, clothe yourself with sackcloth, lament and wail; for the fierce anger of Yahweh hasn’t turned back from us.
translations.bsb: So put on sackcloth, mourn and wail, for the fierce anger of the LORD has not turned away from us.”
translations.kjv: For this gird you with sackcloth, lament and howl: for the fierce anger of the LORD is not turned back
translations.asv: For this gird you with sackcloth, lament and wail; for the fierce anger of Jehovah is not turned back from us.
